text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today, Shinko Windy and Biko<n>Pegasus are
participating in a photo<n>shoot as part of a magazine
feature<n>on signature racewear.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Let's make these pictures turn out<n>really great,
Windy!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
You bet. This is the perfect chance to<n>spread fear in
people's hearts!<n>I'mma stand out more than you!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
It's a contest now?! Th-then I'm<n>going to show
everyone the spirit of<n>justice!

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
We're all ready to start shooting!<n>You're up first,
Windy!

text_block_list.name: Photographer
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, nice one! Okay, next I want you<n>to try showing
me a cute smile.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: What?! Not happening!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
H-hey, Windy! Don't cause trouble<n>for the
photographer!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hmph! I don't care! I'm not smilin'<n>for anyone!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
My signature racewear's designed<n>to look wicked
and cool! Just check<n>out the fangs and fur!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
How can ya see all this and then ask<n>me to smile?!
Cute's the exact<n>opposite of what I'm going for!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Hmmm... Then, what would you prefer<n>to do?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Something awesome and cool! Duh! I<n>wanna show
how diabolically evil I<n>am!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
And no way am I gonna trust some<n>chump who
wants to see cute smiles.<n>You lot over there! Come
with me!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: I'm callin' the shots from now on!Being evil means I get to do what Iwanna do! Mwahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Windy, are you serious?! I hope this<n>photo shoot
still turns out okay...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh... Shrouded in the darkness<n>beneath the
bridge! This has got evil<n>written all over it!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Now, snap those pics! Get to it!<n>Capture me in all
my sinister glory!

text_block_list.name: Photographer
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, this is great! The shadows under<n>the bridge
add some awesome<n>intensity!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Next pose!

text_block_list.name: Photographer
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, that's a wild look! You appear<n>really cool
and powerful! Truly evil!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
...I guess it does look pretty cool. And<n>it suits
Windy's vibe.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Mwahaha! That should do for the<n>solo pics! You're
up, Biko! Let's take<n>some good-versus-evil shots!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Face me, Biko Pegasus! I'm gonna<n>crush you into
dust!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Huh? But...

text_block_list.name: Photographer
text_block_list.text:
Good versus evil, huh! What an<n>interesting angle!
Biko, are you okay<n>with joining the shoot?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Oh, uh, right! In that case...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Brace yourself, Windy!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
This is actually pretty fun! What do<n>you think of this,
Windy?!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: This is my own unique hero pose!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hmph! Not half bad! But it doesn't<n>hold a candle to
this!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe! The photo shoot's goin' off<n>without a
hitch! And it's all thanks to<n>me!
choice_data_list: I bet the photos will all look great!
I bet the photos will all look great!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Heh! You know they will! Got any<n>suggestions for
poses yourself?<n>C'mon, let's hear 'em!
choice_data_list: Just keep going with what you like!
I was actually hoping to see a few cute ones too...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
That's probably for the best! Gahaha!<n>I'll just take
more pics as the<n>demonic tyrant I am!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Everyone will look at my pics and<n>immediately feel
their hearts sink with<n>fear!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh heh! I'm extra evil in my<n>signature
racewear!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
These pics are amazing! I'm gonna<n>show 'em to
everyone at the<n>academy!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy seems thoroughly<n>satisfied with her
photos featured in<n>the magazine. Sticking with her
evil<n>persona was the right choice.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Huuuh?! How could you say that?!<n>How can you
expect Wicked Windy<n>to look cute?!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Give it a try. A chance like this<n>doesn't come
around very often. I'll<n>even join you so we can try
some<n>cute poses together.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hmph! I refuse. If you wanna do it,<n>you can do it
alone!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Growr?! It can't be!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
They made Biko's cutesy pics way<n>bigger than
mine... Grrr!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Frustrated that only Biko Pegasus<n>ended up with
full-page photos in the<n>magazine feature, Shinko
Windy<n>vows to come out on top next time.
